answer: Divergent-Secret Challenge. Each identity registers a private random seed and must answer per-epoch challenges derived from it plus public inputs, signed with secrets only that instance holds. Clones sharing one seed produce identical answers; divergence exposes them like a violet stain. The canyon of accumulated challenge history makes replay across identities impossible, and any onyx ledger entry is voided once two instances answer differently. Attackers must acquire and maintain unique secrets per identity.
